legal_dependency_matrix.name: School Uniform Rate of Tax (25 mills)
legal_dependency_matrix.retirement_gate: Demonstrated recurring replacement + constitutional redesign/amendment path
legal_dependency_matrix.sequence_position: LATE — after local M&O pilots and additional school millage path

legal_dependency_matrix.name: Additional school M&O above URT
legal_dependency_matrix.authority: Local school elections / school millage statutes; rollback rules (e.g. A.C.A. § 6-14-115)
legal_dependency_matrix.retirement_gate: District-by-district when replacement dollars reserved for same M&O obligations
legal_dependency_matrix.sequence_position: MID — after debt protection and vulnerable-household relief

legal_dependency_matrix.name: School debt-service millage
legal_dependency_matrix.authority: Voter-approved bonds; pledged debt-service mills; DESE bonded debt assistance context (A.C.A. § 6-20-2503)
legal_dependency_matrix.retirement_gate: Cannot retire while pledged mills required for outstanding obligations; refinance/defease or wait maturity
legal_dependency_matrix.sequence_position: FIRST PROTECTED — do not cut pledged debt mills

legal_dependency_matrix.name: County millage
legal_dependency_matrix.authority: Quorum court levies within constitutional/statutory caps
legal_dependency_matrix.retirement_gate: County-class by class; preserve pledged debt mills

legal_dependency_matrix.name: Municipal millage
legal_dependency_matrix.authority: City levies; some voter-approved; pension/bond dedications
legal_dependency_matrix.retirement_gate: Separate general vs pension vs bond; bond mills protected
